text:
mara: quick design check — current metrics panels feel vertically heavy when you have many series. can we propose a "compact legend" mode that reduces legend height + shows a one-line summary?
eli: yes, compact mode makes sense. summary could be something like: '5 series • 2 regions • p95' so it's scannable. expandable on click.
sam: if collapsed, show up to 2 color swatches + abbreviated names (max 12 chars) inline so users still get color mapping at a glance. hover to reveal full name.
jun: unit behavior note: when zooming the chart we auto-switch units (ms <-> s). that surprises people. new proposal: stick to a base unit per-chart (configurable) and show a small unit-toggle in header for inspection.
mara: agreed. header toggle should show both value and a tooltip with conversion when hovered. also, format numbers using SI prefixes for big values (e.g., 1.2k req/s).
ashley: copy nit: legend menu currently lists "Hide others" — consider changing to "Dim others" to avoid implying deletion. add aria description: "reduce opacity of non-selected series".
prod-analytics: from usage data, 27% of metric dashboards include a single extreme spike that pushes y-axis and hides trend. users often zoom manually.
eli: two approaches: clamp at Xth percentile + show a small inset with full-range sparkline, or keep full-range but show a dashed "zoom to 99th" helper. I lean clamp + inset to preserve trend context.
sam: clamp + inset is good. inset should be clickable to toggle full-range. add aria label like "values clamped at 99th percentile; press enter to toggle full range". also show a badge with the max value in the inset tooltip.
jun: percentiles: suggest 99th by default for latency charts, configurable per-chart via metadata. config keys: visual.clamp_percentile and visual.inset_enabled. example payload for API team:
```
chart: latency
agg: p99
visual.clamp_percentile: 99
visual.inset_enabled: true
visual.smoothing_minutes: 5
```
mara: smoothing control UX: move primary toggle to chart header (on/off). keep slider in right rail for advanced adjustments. when smoothing is on, add faint dashed preview of raw line on hover so users know we're transforming the data. add tooltip text: "smoothed (5m)".
ashley: accessibility checklist: keyboard expand/collapse legend with Enter, arrow keys to move focus across series, space toggles visibility, and clear aria-live announcements when series visibility changes. also ensure color swatches have accessible labels (e.g., "green: api-server-prod").
eli: legend collapse states: default for dashboards = collapsed for panels with >3 series. allow user pref to remember expanded state per-dashboard. small cog menu to "remember legend state".
sam: small visual detail: when collapsed, show an overflow badge like "+3 more" that opens a popover with list. can include per-series min/max badges to surface outliers.
prod-analytics: please capture metrics we need to track after rollout: percent of dashboards using compact legend, clicks on inset, toggles of unit switch, and frequency of "show full range".
design-bot: tagging eng-runtime, eng-platform, and analytics. file a follow-up doc with mocks and ARIA text.
mara: i'll draft the RFC with sketches and copy examples. Eli, can you drop a compact legend mock (SVG) tomorrow?
eli: yep, will do.
jun: i'll write up keyboard mappings and aria attributes and post in this thread.
mara: thanks all — let's keep the proposals small and opt-in for the first iteration. :rocket:
